page.title: Squads
page.empty_no_squads: No squads yet. Create one to get started.

archive_dialog.title: Archive this squad?
archive_dialog.description: "{{name}}" will be archived. Issues currently assigned to this squad will be transferred to its leader. This can't be undone — create a new squad if you need the routing back.

add_member_dialog.title: Add Member
add_member_dialog.description: Add a workspace member or agent to this squad.

discard_changes_dialog.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard_changes_dialog.description: You have unsaved changes on this tab. Switching tabs will discard them.

base_tab.title: Current execution-base distribution
base_tab.description: Shows the actual machine, model, work state, and active work derived from each digital employee's current Runtime binding.
base_tab.projection_notice: This is an observed execution-base projection from current Runtime bindings, not a formal home-base assignment or organization record. Departments stay stable while verified employees may move between bases.
base_tab.load_error: Base and Runtime information is unavailable
base_tab.load_error_description: Department members remain visible, but HiveCrew cannot safely determine which machines currently execute these digital employees.
base_tab.empty_title: No digital employees in this department
base_tab.empty_description: Human members are never inferred to be Runtimes. Add a digital employee with a Runtime binding to see its execution base here.

instructions_tab.description: Squad instructions are injected into the leader agent's prompt whenever it works on an issue assigned to this squad. Use them to give the leader squad-wide guidance, working agreements, or context the leader should follow on every task.
